node.statement: Choose a finite nonnegative universal coefficient c0 for which lem-maincb-error-improvement remains valid: starting from its finite universal error coefficient, enlarge it to a nonnegative coefficient if necessary, and use lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone to preserve each resulting inclusion conclusion. Fix the corresponding L^0>=1 and e_env^0>0 supplied by lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope. Make the fixed compressed-corner-unit witness choices occurring in the premise of lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum, and then fix its universal C_cross^0>=1 and e_cross^0>0 witnesses. Define K_3^0:=max{1,e_cross^0/e_env^0}. Then K_3^0 is finite and universal, K_3^0>=1, and e_cross^0/K_3^0<=e_env^0; this absorbs the direct-envelope smallness prerequisite, while the ledger lower bounds on W.K3 absorb the remaining displayed Stage-3 scalar prerequisites.
